title: With nothing to cast, play the tapped land
briefing: P1 holds Temple of Mystery (enters tapped, scries 1) and an Island and has nothing else to cast this turn. Playing the tapped land now costs nothing; saving it for a turn with a spell to cast would cost tempo later.

reference.analysis: No spell in hand, so this turn's mana is unused either way. Temple enters tapped at no cost and scries 1; the Island is untapped but pointless now, and the Temple would cost a tapped land on a later turn that has a spell.

options.label: Play Temple of Mystery
options.why: The tapped land costs nothing now and scries.

options.label: Play Island
options.why: Legal and harmless, but pushes the tapped land to a turn where it will cost tempo.

otherwise.why: Skips the land drop for no reason.
